process.title: Four course shifts that make leadership feel clearer.
process.lead: Not a module marathon. We work like a map and compass: first your position, then the direction, then the next conversations in real work.
process.note: Every session ends with one small, concrete experiment for the next two weeks. Reflection turns into leadership behaviour you can actually test with your team.

steps.title: Untangle the role noise
steps.description: We surface expectations, pressure points and unspoken questions before jumping to solutions.
steps.outcome: You know what is really on the table.

steps.title: Set your leadership north
steps.description: Your real situations become a clear focus: which stance, which boundaries and which conversations matter now.
steps.outcome: You stop leading everything at once and start with what counts.

steps.title: Prepare the key conversations
steps.description: We translate insight into wording, decisions and small experiments for your everyday work.
steps.outcome: You enter difficult moments with language, not a knot in your stomach.

steps.title: Make clarity sustainable
steps.description: At the end we test what holds, what still wobbles and which routines keep you steady after coaching.
steps.outcome: You leave with a personal leadership compass.

trust.title: Before we talk about the programme: this stays protected.
trust.lead: Good leadership does not start when you sound perfect. It starts when you can name what feels uncertain without being judged for it.
trust.proofValue: Protected space, clear work, no invented proof.
trust.imageAlt: A coach and client in a calm 1:1 conversation at a table, taking notes – a confidential, protected coaching space.

points.title: Confidentiality without fine print
points.description: Everything you bring stays in the coaching. Names, conflicts and internal dynamics are not turned into material.

points.title: Real situations, not role-play theatre
points.description: We work on conversations, decisions and friction points that are genuinely on your desk this week.

points.title: Feedback that stays clear
points.description: You do not get comfort phrases. I reflect what I see, then we turn it into one next action.

points.title: Structure without a drawer
points.description: The frame keeps the course for eight weeks. The content comes from your role, your team and your pace.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Answered briefly and honestly – just like a real intro call.

items.question: Who is this coaching for?
items.answer: For new and aspiring leaders who want to shape their role deliberately – regardless of industry or team size.

items.question: How do the sessions work?
items.answer: The eight sessions take place online via video, every two weeks, with 60 minutes for your topic each time.

items.question: What if I get stuck in between?
items.answer: Between sessions you have a short sparring option to quickly make sense of urgent situations.

items.question: Do I need leadership experience already?
items.answer: No. The programme fits both before your first leadership step and in the first months of the new role.

items.question: Is this a real offer?
items.answer: No. KlarKompass is a demo: a fictional concept project showing how a modern coaching landing page can look.
